title: [Bug Report] [PdfCraft] No effect on PDF File Size after Page Deletion
relevance: shared deletion/resource lifecycle concern; PDF revision model differs
rationale: PdfCraft’s observed retained text comes from incremental PDF revisions; linked #2165 confirms the same model, while DesignCraft #566 was closed after the reporter traced slowdown to a corrupt image. Varve deletes the page subtree, collects unreferenced embedded image assets while preserving shared references, and serializes the current scene as a fresh .varve snapshot. This does not establish PDF page-editing support.
linked_evidence: PdfCraft #2165 body/comment read; DesignCraft #566 body/comments read; attachment URL present but inaccessible through web reader; no source image downloaded

title: Atomic save does not propagate staging-file close errors
rationale: The staging File is now closed through io-close before atomic replace. An injected close failure returns a save error, preserves the original destination, and removes the staging file. The targeted native test passed; the full local gate was interrupted at the architecture audit and remains incomplete.

title: [Bug Report] [PdfCraft] cant edit
relevance: outside current product capability; partial PDF artwork import only
evidence: packages/import/src/pdf.ts::createPdfParser/parsePdfSync; packages/import/src/formatCapabilities.ts PDF capabilities; apps/website/src/pages/docs/file-formats.astro corrected PDF limits
rationale: The source report lacks reproduction steps beyond editing a PDF filled/signed in Acrobat. Varve does not edit or re-save source PDFs, fill AcroForm fields, preserve PDF signatures, or flatten PDF annotations; its partial importer extracts simple text and rectangle operators. The source attachment could not be inspected. Related #3339/#2149/#2348 describe PdfCraft annotation-flattening controls, #1696 requests inline PDF form filling, and #2804 is an unreproduced PDF text-edit report without its sample. The public file-formats guide now states the actual limit and no longer promises multi-page conversion.
linked_evidence: #3339 #2149 #1696 #2804 bodies/comments and PR #2348 description read; issue image attachment inaccessible through web reader; no PDF sample provided

title: [Bug] GUI hangs on PDF with corrupt incremental-update xref and blocks all later file opens (Windows, 0.9.0)
relevance: adjacent import responsiveness risk; no matching PDF-reader or xref parser
evidence: packages/import/src/pdf.ts::parsePdfSync; packages/import/src/service.ts::importOne/importFiles; issue thread and linked PR descriptions #2220 #1634 #3415 #3416 read; original PDF unavailable
rationale: PdfCraft reports stale-xref recovery and single-instance PDF open blocking. Varve has no PDF reader/OS-open PDF path; its partial artwork importer synchronously decodes/scans whole PDF bytes but does not parse xref tables. This is an adjacent responsiveness test opportunity, not a reproduced Varve defect. Linked PR descriptions #2220, #1634, #3415, and #3416 and immediate possibly-related issues #625, #2458, #1937, #2384, and #1449 were read; deeper links from the corpus/signature issues remain pending.

rationale: The report identifies stale, hand-written macOS Devanagari font paths in PdfCraft. title: Copy and Find put spaces between Chinese characters spread by character spacing (分散對齊): 「受文者」 copies as 「受 文 者」 and isn't found
evidence: cutoff-D body and full thread; linked #3711/#3712/#3172 bodies and #3722 PR body reviewed; Varve packages/import/src/pdf.ts::extractPdfText inspected
rationale: The report concerns PdfCraft’s full-PDF glyph arrangement, copy, and Find path. Its inline synthetic reproduction uses PDF character spacing (Tc); linked PR #3722 proposes a glyph-position spacing heuristic and pins all nine spacing steps plus separate-cell controls (PR was open at Cutoff D). Varve’s PDF importer is explicitly partial: extractPdfText concatenates literal strings from Tj/TJ operators and does not build positioned PDF glyph runs or expose PDF-page selection/copy. It does not infer word gaps from glyph geometry, so the reported insertion of spaces between spread CJK characters is not the same failure path. The issue’s self-contained standard-library repro is inline; no external sample was needed or downloaded.
linked_evidence: #3711 and #3712 full bodies reviewed as adjacent vertical-text selection issues; #3172 body reviewed as overprinted-run extraction; #3722 fix PR body and test description reviewed; no Varve defect demonstrated
